_comment: Per-class manifest of ALL NUMERIC VALUES that have ever appeared in a brief for this class. Used by gate 25 (brief-value-literal-scanner) to flag stale literals that match HISTORICAL values (even if the current brief has a different value). Seeded from git log on brief files 2026-05-27 (L42). Write-back: when a brief is rewritten and new values are introduced, append them here.
_write_back_rule: On each chain run, any new brief value not already in the manifest for its class should be appended. This is checked by the extended gate 25 scanner (historical-brief-values extension).

bess_container._source: git log on src/lib/pdf-engine-v2/briefs/baseline-10/09-bess-container.md — commits ce8fde2af, f8efb3f4d, 2e367e15b, 9301f9619

_notes.historical_only_means_stale: A value in historical_values that is NOT the current brief value is STALE. Gate 25 should flag HIGH if it appears as a literal in deterministic-emitter.ts.
_notes.ambiguous_means_current_or_historical: A value that IS the current brief value could be either current-use OR a coincidental stale literal from a prior brief. Gate 25 flags these as MED (ambiguous).
_notes.how_to_extend: When adding a new product class: run `git log --oneline -- <brief-file>` and `git show <sha>:<brief-file>` for each commit to extract all historical numeric values. Add the class key matching the class_name field in moduleDecomposition.product_class.
